systems_found: SC public senior institutions (USC system, Clemson, College of Charleston, MUSC, Winthrop, Coastal Carolina, SC State, The Citadel, Francis Marion, Lander), each with its own board, overseen by the SC Commission on Higher Education
SC Technical College System (16 technical colleges)

sources.institution: All state agencies, colleges and universities under DSHR oversight (USC campuses, Clemson, CofC, MUSC, Winthrop, Coastal, SC State, Citadel, Francis Marion, Lander, all 16 technical colleges)
sources.system: SC Department of Administration - State Salaries Query
sources.coverage_years: current fiscal year only (page says last updated September 16, 2026)
sources.institutions_covered: all public 4-year institutions and technical colleges (e.g. 'AIKEN TECHNICAL COLLEGE' in the agency list); excludes MUSC Hospital Authority and a list of legislative/judicial bodies
sources.employees: FTE employees earning $50,000 or more (by FOIA rule; lower pay is released only in ranges)
sources.format: HTML table (Drupal view, 25 rows per page, about 1,800 pages, so roughly 45,000 rows)
sources.update_frequency: periodic (several times a year; last update 2026-09-16)
sources.terms: not stated; disclaimer that Admin cannot guarantee accuracy, and that the data 'should not be used for comparison purposes'
sources.blocker: No bulk download; current year only; must page through about 1,800 HTML pages (plain GET, no form POST or CAPTCHA), and employees under $50k are omitted.
sources.notes: Clean, consistent HTML table that is easy to scrape politely. For colleges and universities, 'total compensation does not include all types of pay and bonuses'; university staff who are dually employed with other agencies are excluded. No department field. Total compensation = annual salary or year-to-date actual earnings, whichever is greater. Search results mention older cached versions that offered a downloadable file of salaries over $50,000; none is linked now. No history, so snapshots would have to be taken over time.

sources.url: https://www.thestate.com/ (state salary database article, syndicated via AOL: 'How much do certain SC state employees get paid? Check out our state salary database')
sources.blocker: Newspaper site blocked to our fetcher and likely paywalled; it republishes the official Admin data.

private_extra: None found; Furman, Wofford, Presbyterian etc. publish only IRS 990 data.
gaps: No bulk file; no history (current snapshot only); employees under $50k listed only as ranges or omitted; college pay excludes some pay types; no department field. MUSC Hospital Authority not included.
notes: Used plain GET pagination of the Drupal view (one test page fetched). This is a URL query, not a form submission, so it is rated B rather than C. Did not look at individual campus sites because the state query covers all of them.
